results.text: Serum Concentration of Apixaban in Relation to Renal Function in Older Hospitalized Patients. Apixaban is the most prescribed direct-acting oral anticoagulant drug. According to its product information, clearance is only partially renal. However, little is known about the impact of renal function on apixaban pharmacokinetics in real-world settings.
